description.value: +2 status bonus to saves against possession, mental control, and incorporeal intrusion for the duration; any such effect that would take hold on a single failed save instead requires two consecutive successful attempts against the target.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +2 status bonus to saves vs. possession/mental control/incorporeal intrusion is already correctly built as the companion hollowbound.shut-the-door-effect.json Effect record (a real FlatModifier, matching pf2e's own Bind Undead spell + spell-effect-bind-undead.json pattern of a spell staying rules: [] while its companion Effect carries the mechanic) -- no action needed on that half. The separate "any such effect that would normally take hold on one failed save instead requires two consecutive successful saves to resist" clause is unbuilt: it is not in shut-the-door-effect.json's own rules (confirmed by direct read: exactly one FlatModifier entry, nothing else), and converting "single failure triggers" into "two consecutive successes required to resist" is not something AdjustDegreeOfSuccess can do -- it only reclassifies the result of an actual roll that happens, it doesn't change how many rolls are required in the first place. No other rule element tracks a per-target consecutive-success counter gating whether an external effect takes hold.
